newsitem.title: USA: IVAX gets FDA OK for generic etodolac.
newsitem.headline: IVAX gets FDA OK for generic etodolac.

text.p: IVAX Corp on Wednesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved an abbreviated new drug application for the generic pharmaceutical product etodolac in 200 and 300 mg capsules.
The company said that this approval follows IVAX's March 1997 approval for etodolac in 400 mg tablets.
Etodolac is indicated for the long-term management of osteoarthritis and pain and is the generic equivalent of Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories' Lodine.
Wyeth-Ayerst is a subsidiary of American Home Products Corp.
The product will be marketed by IVAX's wholly-owned subsidiary, Zenith Goldline Pharmaceuticals Inc, and shipping has commenced, the company said.
